2-mb-binary-zero.8da17e: ~2 MB binary. Zero external dependencies. Polls every 2 seconds with efficient ring buffers. Shows its own memory usage in the footer.
_meta.description: Everything Blip does on the Mac, iPhone and iPad: CPU, memory, disk and S.M.A.R.T., network and traceroute, GPU, battery and fans, Blip Bench, speed tests, widgets and Shortcuts.
a-dismissable-suggestion-points.300ca8: A dismissable suggestion points out what's slowing your Mac down or wearing it out: runaway apps, memory pressure, heavy swap, thermal throttling, a nearly full disk, low SSD life or weak battery health.
app-memory-wired-compressed.7b586f: App memory, wired, compressed breakdown matching Activity Monitor. Swap usage, cached files, kernel-level pressure indicator. Accurate phys_footprint memory per process.
apple-silicon-gpu-utilization.1dced7: Apple Silicon GPU utilization percentage with renderer name. Historical usage chart shows GPU load over time with smooth monotone interpolation.
bench-score-storage-and.p4b008: Bench score, storage, and your last speed test on the Home Screen — each stamped with its age — plus Shortcuts to automate benchmarks, speed tests, and stats snapshots.
blip-comes-to-iphone.d19c44: Blip comes to iPhone and iPad — and Blip Bench scores every device on one scale, Neural Engine included.
blip-monitors-what-matters.1b2428: Blip monitors what matters and stays out of your way.
built-by-blaine-miller.9d6375: Built by Blaine Miller · Open Source under MIT License
category-colors-monochrome-or.e91d91: Category colors, monochrome, or custom color via picker. Optional utilization colorization. Two layouts (horizontal/stacked). Toggle individual items and labels. Launch at login.
charge-level-health-matching.ef367e: Charge level, health matching Settings app, battery condition, cycle count, temperature, charging status. Fan RPM with min/max ranges.
cpu-memory-gpu-and.p1b002: CPU, memory, GPU, and Neural Engine throughput in fixed reference units — one scale for every Mac, iPhone, and iPad running Blip, with a sustained phase that measures thermal throttling.
download-and-upload-draw.p2b004: Download and upload draw as separate curves, latency is measured idle and under load, and every result is graded per activity — from video calls to cloud gaming.
eight-actions-put-blip.7cef12: Eight actions put Blip's numbers and tests into your own automations, with 37 live metrics you can chain on the Mac.
everything-you-need-nothing.82ffca: Everything you need, nothing you don't.
five-zero-setup-app.b51c76: Five zero-setup App Shortcut phrases — say them to Siri or type them into Spotlight, no setup required.
historical-sparklines-for-cpu.66aab6: Historical sparklines for CPU, memory, and GPU. Bandwidth and disk I/O charts with auto-scaled Y-axis labels. Detail panels live-refresh as data changes.
live-upload-and-download.e54d66: Live upload and download, session totals, every interface, router and WAN ping, IPv4 and IPv6, VPN detection, a live traceroute with per-hop loss and latency on an offline map, and a multi-gigabit speed test against a public server or your own.
no-telemetry-no-tracking.dc76f0: No telemetry, no tracking, no analytics and no servers. Traceroute locations come from an optional database on your own device, and the only connections Blip makes are the ones you start.
one-free-app-across.s8b174: One free app across Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Live device cards with drill-in details, Blip Bench with Neural Engine scoring, graded speed tests, ping and traceroute with an offline hop map, disk speed tests, widgets, and Shortcuts.
optional-download-blip-helper.57ce2c: Optional: Download Blip Helper for fan speeds, temperatures, GPU utilization, disk I/O, battery health, and process monitoring when using the App Store version.
ping-and-traceroute-over.p3b006: Ping and traceroute with per-hop latency and an offline GeoIP map of the route. The location database downloads once; lookups never leave the device.
space-on-every-volume.db083c: Space on every volume, live read and write speeds, and full S.M.A.R.T. health (SSD life, temperature, lifetime writes, power-on hours), external SSDs included. A built-in speed test benchmarks any volume in one click.
the-top-cpu-and.a5b3cc: The top CPU and memory users, with their app icons and accurate per-process numbers. Hover a process to quit it right from the panel.
total-and-per-core.b102a8: Total and per-core usage, user/system/idle breakdown, load averages (1m/5m/15m), P-core and E-core counts. Accurate delta-based CPU per process with app icons.
your-devices-vitals-at.cb380c: Your devices' vitals, at a glance.
